dedupe_keys.name: turboroute alignment sheet generator entrust solutions group arcmap extension

description: TurboRoute Alignment Sheet Generator is a customisable Esri ArcMap extension from ENTRUST Solutions Group that generates alignment sheets and area maps from a pipeline GIS. The Esri partner page describes two tool sets: user tools for people who generate, view and print alignment sheets, and advanced tools that let a template designer lay out and design new sheets. The same vendor lists related pipeline data management tools on the page, including line maintenance for centerline operations, event maintenance for facility records, a control point editor and a data explorer for pipeline geodatabases. Coverage: pipeline systems held in an Esri geodatabase. Format and access: a commercial desktop extension listed in Esri's partner catalogue. Licence and cost: paid, proprietary. Caveats: it targets ArcMap, not ArcGIS Pro, and the page gives no data model versions or pricing. It supports hazard exposure reviews along pipeline routes through maps and sheets built from the GIS. It relates to SheetCutter Pro and ArcGIS with UPDM in the catalogue.
